history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: United Kingdom (blind all fours), USA (auction pitch/setback)
Time Period: Mid 19th century (auction pitch); blind all fours in England earlier
Historical Development: Pitch is an American trick-taking game equivalent to British blind all fours, derived from classic all fours (seven up). The modern game with bidding and setback developed in the USA in the mid-19th century.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in the USA and UK; pub game in northern England.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
